verdict.rationale: Mercury ships several of its own background automations: automatic invoices (mercury-docs-4), receipts auto-attached to card transactions (mercury-docs-5), and AI-powered bookkeeping automations synced to accounting tools (mercury-docs-6). A long-time customer also reports purpose-named accounts with auto-funding rules (mercury-comm-1). However, these are fixed, feature-specific automations rather than a general facility for users to define autonomous background workflows. Broader autonomy depends on developer building blocks (API, webhooks, CLI in CI), which earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation/rules builder or scheduled agent runs, documentation of how auto-funding rules are set up, and independent corroboration of the AI automations working autonomously.
